name: 💵 MOW A LAWN!
desc:
🗣️ Mow the grass before Grandpa gets ANGRY! An incremental simulator game where you buy upgrades, hatch pets and progress through various areas! Complete quests and reach the top of the leaderboards!

👍 LIKE THE GAME for MORE UPDATES and CODES!
NEW CODE EVERY 100 Likes!


🍃 Help Grandpa mow his lawn!

💵 Earn cash and buy upgrades!

😺 Hatch eggs and get pets to help you mow!

🔄 Retire and rebirth! Unlock permanent upgrades!

🏴‍☠️ Find the black market... Collect trading cards and complete your collection!
